implementation_choices.frozen_text_is_ambiguous_about: prereg section 4 defines body_hash as 'SHA256 of the full HTTP response body' of the item's page_url, and rules 2 and 3 disagree about whether within-session constancy is tested on the VALUE alone (rule 2 operational test) or on VALUE and body_hash together (rule 2 prose and rule 3 prose).
implementation_choices.resolution_applied: PRIMARY implements the prose reading: a within-session instance is the PAIR (value, body_hash) for rules 2 and 3. The value-only reading is computed in parallel and reported as derived/classification_sensitivity.json; it never overrides the primary.
implementation_choices.effect_on_result: Decisive for the class of any item whose page body changes between two requests 1 s apart inside one session.

implementation_choices.frozen_text_is_ambiguous_about: prereg section 4 says 'In each session, we fetch the item's page URL' but the KNOWN_STATIONARY_CONTROL designates two items that are LINKS DISCOVERED ON THE ROOT page. Under a literal reading their body_hash is the ROOT page body, which is not a stationary resource; under a resource reading it is the linked resource's body.
implementation_choices.resolution_applied: PRIMARY follows the literal reading: page_url for those two items is the root page the link was observed on. A secondary resource-level probe of the linked target is recorded separately in raw/http.jsonl phase=secondary_resource_probe and summarised as a disclosed sensitivity. It never overrides the primary.
implementation_choices.effect_on_result: Decisive for the KNOWN_STATIONARY_CONTROL verdict on the two root nav-link items.

implementation_choices.frozen_text_is_ambiguous_about: prereg section 4's tie-break 'the first matching class in the table order applies' lists session_scoped BEFORE time_scoped and rotating, while rules 4 and 5 are both defined as refinements of the session-scoped pattern. Rule 2 therefore matches first and rules 4 and 5 are unreachable.
implementation_choices.resolution_applied: The frozen order is applied unchanged to the PRIMARY classification. A secondary post-hoc classification that applies rules 4 and 5 to session-scoped-pattern items is computed and reported separately, explicitly labelled as NOT part of the frozen decision rule.
implementation_choices.effect_on_result: PRIMARY counts for time_scoped and rotating are structurally 0 by construction, so those two classes carry no primary information in this run.

implementation_choices.frozen_text_is_ambiguous_about: prereg section 4's operational test for time_scoped says 'values cycle with period approximately K if delay-controlled', which does not define a computable test.
implementation_choices.resolution_applied: PRIMARY leaves time_scoped unreachable (see IC-03). The secondary classification implements an explicit, declared periodicity statistic on the value series (detected exact-value recurrence) and records it as post-hoc only.
implementation_choices.effect_on_result: Only affects the post-hoc diagnostic, never the frozen decision rule.

implementation_choices.frozen_text_is_ambiguous_about: prereg section 6.2 names https://gitlab.com/users/sign_in for the gitlab CSRF control item while its own header says 'The 4 server-minted CSRF tokens from parent packet', and the parent handoff records the gitlab token at https://gitlab.com/-/trial_registrations/new/.
implementation_choices.resolution_applied: BOTH URLs are executed live. The REVERIFIED_NON_STATIONARY verdict is computed on the prereg-named URL only. The parent-cited URL is reported separately and is never substituted for the prereg-named anchor.
implementation_choices.effect_on_result: Determines the REVERIFIED_NON_STATIONARY control verdict and therefore the frozen controls_gate branch.

implementation_choices.frozen_text_is_ambiguous_about: prereg section 3 states a 2-hop crawl but does not state whether the crawl may leave the starting host, and section 3 also designates two root-page control items by a nominal root URL that three of the six frozen sites redirect away from.
implementation_choices.resolution_applied: The crawl is pinned to the host of the page actually served after redirects, and the effective root is the post-redirect final URL. Redirect facts are recorded per request in raw/http.jsonl and reported as a validity note. No target was substituted.
implementation_choices.effect_on_result: Changes which page the two root-page control items are observed on; it does not change the frozen target pool.

implementation_choices.frozen_text_is_ambiguous_about: prereg section 6.1 makes httpbin.org/sitemap.xml conditional ('if exists, else skip') and no other control item is marked optional.
implementation_choices.resolution_applied: sitemap.xml is executed live; a 404 records the item as absent-and-skipped with n_distinct_values null, never 0.0, and it is excluded from the control verdict by the frozen conditional rather than by producer choice.

implementation_choices.frozen_text_is_ambiguous_about: prereg section 6.2 declares two anchors for the same control element (authenticity_token at the prereg-named /users/sign_in and at the parent-cited /-/trial_registrations/new/) without stating that they are distinct items.
implementation_choices.resolution_applied: item identity includes page_url, so the two anchors are distinct items with distinct per-session records. An earlier pass keyed items by (ctrl_id, element_type, element_name) only, which collapsed the two anchors and discarded the prereg-named anchor's observations; that pass was discarded.
implementation_choices.effect_on_result: Restores the prereg-named REVERIFIED_NON_STATIONARY anchor as an independently reported control item.

implementation_choices.frozen_text_is_ambiguous_about: prereg section 3 designates link items by the absolute URL they point at, while real markup writes hrefs in relative form, and prereg section 4 does not say which form is the item's VALUE.
implementation_choices.resolution_applied: A link is present if the raw href equals the designated URL OR normalises against the page URL to the designated URL; the recorded value is the raw href as served. An earlier pass of this executor compared only raw hrefs to absolute URLs and reported 8 present links as absent; that pass was discarded, its derived outputs were deleted, and the whole run was repeated with the corrected extractor.
implementation_choices.effect_on_result: Moves 8 link items, including one frozen KNOWN_STATIONARY_CONTROL item, from unclassifiable to classified.

implementation_choices.frozen_text_is_ambiguous_about: prereg section 5 defines re_acquisition_cost as the tokens of 'all response bodies + headers observed along the path' without fixing the serialization.
implementation_choices.resolution_applied:
Declared canonical serialization, recorded in every raw observation so any token number is recomputable from the content-addressed cache: '<final_url>
<status>
' followed by every received response header in received order as 'name: value
', followed by the response body decoded utf-8 with replacement.
implementation_choices.effect_on_result: Determines the absolute token values but not the sign of any frozen comparison, which is a difference of two measurements taken under the same serialization.
